claims.content: The C2 JU requests cross-link track identifiers (such as Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1, ATDL-1 TNs, or IJMS SRNs) for a specific track to correlate and maintain consistent track data across different surveillance networks.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU requests cross-link track identifiers (such as Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1, ATDL-1 TNs, or IJMS SRNs) for a specific track to correlate and maintain consistent track data across different surveillance networks.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has operator action initiating the request for cross-link track identifiers.
The C2 JU is capable of assigning or forwarding tracks from Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1, ATDL-1, or IJMS to Link 16.
The C2 JU originates a J7.4 request message as a result of operator action to request cross-link track identifiers (such as Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1, ATDL-1 TNs, or IJMS SRNs).

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU originates a J7.4 request message as a result of operator action to request cross-link track identifiers (such as Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1, ATDL-1 TNs, or IJMS SRNs).

claims.content: The C2 JU originates a J7.4 request message as a result of operator action.
The J7.4 request message is transmitted by the JU which assigns Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1, ATDL-1 TNs, or IJMS SRNs, or forwards tracks from these links to Link 16.
Other JUs respond to the J7.4 request message if they hold additional Track Numbers (TNs) for different links for the requested track.
The latest Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, or IJMS SRN received on a track supersedes previously received data.
After any JU responds to the J7.4 request, other JUs need not respond unless they hold additional Track Numbers (TNs) for different links for the requested track.
There is no other management of track identifier data beyond superseding previously received data with the latest Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, or IJMS SRN received on a track.
The latest Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, or IJMS SRN received on a track supersedes previously received data.
